meta.revisionPolicy: Revised continuously; finalised over ~3 years. Vintages are kept.
meta.coverage: All-India, annual gross capital formation by the industry that uses the asset: 11 industries and 13 sub-industries, constant and current prices, and each industry's share of the total
meta.note: Capital formation by industry of use is published with the revised estimates only. It includes fixed investment, change in stocks and valuables, so the total differs from GFCF. Shares are current prices over the current-price total.
